metadata.case_name: CHEUNG YUEN FAN SALLY v. THE HONG KONG UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

plaintiff.occupation_before: attendant (cleaning) at the student hostel UG2, The Hong Kong University of Science & Technology

injuries.description: diagnosed as suffering from right wrist tendonitis.
source: diagnosed as suffering from right wrist tendonitis.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: diagnosed as having chronic regional pain syndrome involving the right side of her body.
source: diagnosed as having chronic regional pain syndrome involving the right side of her body.

injuries.description: MRI taken of the cervical spine showed reversal of lordosis at C3-4 where there was a right postero-lateral disc prolapse with narrowing of the cervical canal.
source: MRI taken of the cervical spine showed reversal of lordosis at C3-4 where there was a right postero-lateral disc prolapse with narrowing of the cervical canal.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

injuries.description: injuries to her neck and right shoulder which was sustained on 14 February 2000
source: as for the injury to the plaintiff’s neck and right shoulder which was sustained on 14 February 2000

manifestations.description: pain, swelling and redness in her right wrist.
pain affecting her whole upper right limb.
pain ... spread to the right side of the neck, shoulder, arm, forearm and hand.
on and off swelling and temperature fluctuation of right upper limb.
limited movement of right shoulder and right wrist with diffuse tenderness.
headache, dizziness, vertigo, lower pain threshold, depression and sleep disturbance (psychological effects).

treatments_received: four injections between 26 February and 14 March 2000
physiotherapy (admitted into MacLehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre for five months between October 2000 and February 2001)
chiropractic treatment by Dr Albert C.H. Leung
treatment at United Christian Hospital’s Orthopaedic and Traumatology Department
admitted into Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital in mid June 2000
referred to the Pain Team and the Department of Orthopaedic and Traumatology of Queen Mary Hospital
admitted into Tseung Kwan O Hospital from 21 January to 2 February 2007
treatments_future: psychiatric assessment and psychotherapy (recommended by experts)
conservative chiropractic treatment at least once per week for six months (medium term) and at least twice per month for long term maintenance (advised by Dr Leung)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities assessed at $275,000.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Could not render housekeeping and other services previously provided by her to her family (claim for plaintiff's services); awarded $5,000 under special damages.
